### Allow Attach Rebilling
POST /saas/allow-attach-rebilling/{locationId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/saas/allow-attach-rebilling/{locationId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/saas-api/allow-attach-rebilling | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/saas-api/allow-attach-rebilling.md

Marks a SaaS sub-account as awaiting rebilling attach and optionally stores the rebilling configuration that should be applied when the rebilling config is created. Sets payment_pending on the sub-account. Only allowed when the sub-account is in setup_pending state.

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: saas/company.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "AUKAtFVo0lWezBsBQ3FE") - Location ID (Sub-account) to allow attach rebilling for

Request body (required) (application/json) AllowAttachRebillingDto:
- companyId* string (e.g. "5DP4iH6HLkQsiKESj6rh") - Company ID owning the location
- attachedRebillingConfig map<string, object> - Map of rebilling product code to its config. When provided, this gets stored on the sub-account so it can be applied when the rebilling config is created. Omit to only mark the sub-account as awaiting rebilling attach without any pre-configured products. Possible product keys: `contentAI`, `workflow_premium_actions`, `workflow_ai`, `conversationAI`, `whatsApp`, `reviewsAI`, `EmailVerification`, `funnelAI`, `domainPurchase`, `Phone`, `Email`, `agentStudio`, `askai`, `aiStudio`.
  - enabled* boolean - Enable rebilling for this product
  - markup* number (e.g. 3) - Markup multiplier applied on top of the base price, from 1 (1x) to 10 (10x). For domainPurchase the maximum is 3 (3x). Converted internally to a percentage markup (e.g. 2 -> 100%, 3 -> 200%).
  - price number (e.g. 0.0025) - Base price per unit (only applicable for usage based products like EmailVerification, agentStudio, contentAI)

Response 200 (Allow attach rebilling completed successfully) application/json:
- success* boolean - Indicates if the allow attach rebilling operation succeeded
- locationId* string - Location ID the rebilling config was attached to
- attachedRebillingConfig* map<string, object> - Stored rebilling configuration on the location. Markup is the internal percentage value converted from the request multiplier (e.g. 4 -> 300%, 3 -> 200%).
  - enabled* boolean - Enable rebilling for this product
  - markup* number - Markup multiplier applied on top of the base price, from 1 (1x) to 10 (10x). For domainPurchase the maximum is 3 (3x). Converted internally to a percentage markup (e.g. 2 -> 100%, 3 -> 200%).
  - price number - Base price per unit (only applicable for usage based products like EmailVerification, agentStudio, contentAI)

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422, 500 (400, 401: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Resource not found) application/json:
- statusCode number - Status code
- message string - Error message
Response 422 (Unprocessable entity (e.g. sub-account already in saas mode activated, or not in setup_pending state)) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 500 (Internal server error) application/json:
- statusCode number - Status code
- message string - Error message

  - option 2 EnableSaasV2ResponseDto: object - SaaS v2 enable response (returned when isSaaSV2 is true).

### List agency wallet transactions
POST /saas/companies/{companyId}/wallet-transactions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/saas/companies/{companyId}/wallet-transactions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/saas-api/list-agency-wallet-transactions | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/saas-api/list-agency-wallet-transactions.md

Fetch paginated wallet transactions for an agency (company). Supports skip/limit pagination, date-range and charge-type filters, timezone normalization, and additional non-indexed filters in the request body.

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: saas/company.read

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- companyId* string (e.g. "5DP4iH6HLkQsiKESj6rh") - Company ID to list transactions for

Request body (required) (application/json) ListWalletTransactionsV2RequestDto:
- skip number (min: 0; e.g. 0) - Number of records to skip for pagination. Defaults to 0 when omitted.
- limit number (min: 0; max: 1000; e.g. 100) - Maximum number of records to return. Capped at 1000 per request.
- filters object - Transaction filters
  - locationId string (e.g. "AUKAtFVo0lWezBsBQ3FE") - Filter by location ID
  - settlementTime object - Settlement time range filter
  - chargeType string | string[] (e.g. "Email") - Charge type filter
    - option 1: string
    - option 2: string[]
- timezone string (e.g. "UTC") - Timezone for date normalization
- users any[][] - User identifiers to scope transaction results
- additionalFilter object - Additional non-indexed filters

Response 200 (Wallet transactions retrieved successfully) application/json:
- transactions* any[][] - Flat list of normalized wallet transaction records returned from blade-platform

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 500 (400, 401: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Resource not found) application/json:
- statusCode number - Status code
- message string - Error message
Response 500 (Internal server error) application/json:
- statusCode number - Status code
- message string - Error message

POST /saas/update-rebilling/{companyId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/saas/update-rebilling/{companyId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/saas-api/update-rebilling | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/saas-api/update-rebilling.md

Bulk update rebilling for given locationIds

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: saas/company.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- companyId* string

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateRebillingDto:
- product* string (enum: workflow_premium_actions | EmailVerification | contentAI | workflow_ai | whatsApp | reviewsAI | domainPurchase | agentStudio | askai | aiStudio | conversation_AI | voiceAI | Email | Phone; e.g. "contentAI") - The product to update rebilling for
- locationIds* string[] (e.g. ["zzyG7A4x6bRJl5SlhQhH","Vygq7VgXCDfg3xnl8TBR"]) - Array of location IDs to update rebilling for
- config* object - Configuration for rebilling settings
  - optIn boolean - Enable the product for the locations
  - enabled boolean - Enable the rebilling for the locations
  - markup number (e.g. 5) - Additional value to be added in terms of percentage. For example, if the product price is $100 and the markup is 5, the amount charged to will be $105.

Response 201 (Result of the bulk rebilling update.) application/json:
- success* boolean - Indicates if the rebilling update was successful
- location_updated* string[] - IDs of the sub-accounts whose rebilling was updated
- message string - Human-readable summary of the outcome (present on success/partial updates)
- error* string (nullable) - Reason some or all locations failed to update; null on full success
